# TEKJEE

> 24/7 Live Virtual Camera Monitoring, AI Automation, and Digital Transformation Solutions for US & UK Businesses.

TEKJEE provides real-time, proactive video surveillance, AI workflow automation, CRM automation, and back-office outsourcing. We specialize in safeguarding physical facilities — including gas stations, commercial warehouses, retail stores, restaurants and hospitality venues — with rapid response times (under 60 seconds) and scalable technology solutions.

## Core Services

- [Digital Marketing Agency](https://tekjee.com/virtual-marketing.html): B2B digital marketing agency for small business in the USA and UK. Generative engine optimization (GEO) and AI search optimization first, plus SEO and Local SEO, social media marketing, paid ads on every social platform, branding and graphic design, for businesses without an in-house marketing team.
- [Commercial Security Cameras & Video Monitoring](https://tekjee.com/camera-monitoring.html): commercial security camera systems with installation, 24/7 live and remote video monitoring, virtual security guard services with two-way voice talk-down, CCTV monitoring, business alarm video verification, cloud storage and emergency dispatch.
- [AI Automation Agency](https://tekjee.com/ai-automation.html): custom AI bots for business and customer service, agentic AI workflows, enterprise AI automation services, a Virtual Manager, and AI automation for logistics, retail, restaurants and hospitality, with measurable ROI within 60 days.
- [CRM Automation Services](https://tekjee.com/crm-automation.html): CRM workflow automation, automated lead follow-up within 2 minutes, sales pipeline automation, lead management automation, and HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Zoho and Salesforce automation.
- [Back Office Support](https://tekjee.com/camera-monitoring.html#back-office): Part of Camera Surveillance & Virtual Management. Back office support services and outsourcing: transaction reconciliation, back office bookkeeping (QuickBooks and Xero), payroll, data entry and virtual back office assistants aligned with US and UK business hours at up to 60% lower cost, run by the same team that monitors your cameras.
- [Web Design & Development](https://tekjee.com/web-development.html): SEO and GEO-ready website development — custom business websites, e-commerce stores, landing pages and web apps with technical SEO, Local SEO, schema markup and Generative Engine Optimization built in.
- SEO & GEO: Local SEO, Technical SEO, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) so a business ranks on Google and is cited by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity.
